## Type of Change

- [ ] `docs` — documentation change
- [ ] `feat` — new artefact or capability
- [ ] `fix` — correction
- [ ] `refactor` — restructuring without behaviour change
- [ ] `chore` / `ci` — tooling or automation

## AIBOS Standards Checklist

- [ ] Follows the [Style Guide](../00_ROOT/AIBOS_STYLE_GUIDE.md) (British English, RFC 2119).
- [ ] Conforms to the [Document Schema](../00_ROOT/AIBOS_DOCUMENT_SCHEMA.md).
- [ ] Uses approved terminology from the [Glossary](../00_ROOT/AIBOS_ENTERPRISE_GLOSSARY.md).
- [ ] File and directory names follow the [Naming Standard](../00_ROOT/AIBOS_NAMING_STANDARD.md).
- [ ] Cross-references are valid; no duplicated content.
- [ ] Version history and [`CHANGELOG.md`](../CHANGELOG.md) updated.
- [ ] [`ROOT_INDEX.md`](../ROOT_INDEX.md) updated if artefacts were added or moved.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or personal data committed.
